findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 4 (floor: data loss)
Raise: Data loss — When an item saved before `known` is reviewed twice at the same task commit, `_known` backfills from `review._history`, which keys results by commit and retains only the later result. An earlier below-bar or owner-accepted finding omitted from that later review never enters `known`. After a squash merge, the item's promised record of that finding is lost. This is a further harm beyond the earlier settled finding about what appears in review prompts.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Not done — The new area-stop paragraph sits below guidance in this same shipped skill that says close holds the fourth review after any three blocked rounds and that a read stops after any three blocked reads. The worker brief repeats those unconditional rules in `worker.REVIEW_LOOP`. Item 4 now permits another round for new low-Harm findings, so coordinators and workers receive instructions that contradict the behavior this change delivers.
